people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”
translations.bsb: So for this reason I have called to see you and speak with you. It is because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain.”
translations.kjv: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
translations.asv: For this cause therefore did I entreat you to see and to speak with me: for because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
